name: fusion-minimal
description: Configure coordinator and worker models, prepare bounded handoffs, and verify compact evidence without automatically starting tasks.

interface.longDescription: Local MCP App and native structured settings share model selections with future Fusion task handoffs. No model launch, running-thread model switch, or Hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Fusion Minimal to prepare one bounded task and verify its evidence. Ask before any real dual-model run.
